project_type: PHP + PDO + MySQL + Tailwind CSS (CDN). PWA with Firebase Cloud Messaging.
build_system: None (plain PHP served by Apache/XAMPP). Composer for Firebase SDK dependency.
test_framework: None (no automated tests). Manual verification via PHP syntax check.
verification_instructions: Run php -l on all modified PHP files to ensure no syntax errors.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - plain PHP project. Composer autoload is used for Firebase SDK.
environment_constraints: Open internet. No database available for testing - validate via PHP syntax only. No iniciar_sesion_padres.php exists - parent pages use inline session config (30-day cookie lifetime with session_start).
contribution_requirements: Follow existing coding patterns. Use same Tailwind CSS classes and color scheme (bg-crema, text-vino, bg-vino, text-dorado). Use same font families (Playfair Display, Plus Jakarta Sans).
key_patterns: PDO with named parameters. Session auth check: $_SESSION['tutor_autenticado']. Admin auth: $_SESSION['usuario_autenticado']. API endpoints return JSON with 'success' boolean. Push notifications via enviarAlertaFirebase($token, $mensaje) which sends data-only FCM messages. Parent session vars: tutor_autenticado, alumno_matricula, tutor_nombre, alumnos (array). dispositivos_padres table stores FCM tokens with columns: id, matricula_alumno, token_fcm, fecha_registro.
directory_structure: Root: PHP files (login, portals, APIs). admin/: Admin panel pages with includes/ subdir for layout partials. api/: JSON API endpoints. config/: Firebase service-account.json. No sql/ directory yet.
